table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	SalesTaxSchedule=ST.Name,
	AdvanceTaxAmt=SUM(P.AdvanceTaxamt),
	PurAmt=SUM(D.PurPrice * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty)),
	Discount=SUM((D.PurPrice * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
	TaxAmt =SUM((D.PurPrice * (D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) + ((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax))
FROM 
	PurLedger P, 
	PurDetail D, 
	Supplier S, 
	SupplierCategory SC, 
	Accounts A, 
	Item I,
	SalesTaxSchedule ST
WHERE 
	SC.SuppCatCode IN (:ai_suppcatcode) AND
	SC.SuppCatCode = S.SuppCatCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	S.SuppCode = P.SuppCode AND
	P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND
	P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.SalesTaxScheduleCode = ST.SalesTaxScheduleCode
GROUP BY
	ST.Name,
	ST.TaxPerc
